summary_zh: 本页为绘本《美国国家地理探索世界双语小百科：太空》的封面，展示了行星、星云和星空的插图，并包含书名、作者、译者及出版社信息。

page_text_ocr_zh:
看, 地球!
Look, it's planet Earth!
从遥远的地方往下看, 我们的地球就像一颗由蓝色、白色和绿色混合而成的漂浮弹珠。这颗“弹珠”里的东西多着呢!
From way up high, our planet looks like a floating marble of blue, white, and green.
But we know that it's so much more.
page_text_en:
Look, it's planet Earth!
From way up high, our planet looks like a floating marble of blue, white, and green.
But we know that it's so much more.
summary_zh: 本页展示了从太空视角观察地球的图像，并用中英文介绍了地球看起来像一颗由蓝、白、绿三色组成的漂浮弹珠，同时指出地球远比表面所见更加丰富。

page_text_ocr_zh:
地球上有宽广的大海，也有小小的池塘；有高高的山峰，也有连绵的小山。
Earth has giant oceans and tiny ponds, towering mountains and rolling hilltops.
地球上四季分明：春天阳光明媚，夏天雷雨阵阵，秋天落叶飘零，冬天雪花飞舞。
Warm sunshine. Stormy showers. Falling autumn leaves. And fluffy snowflakes.
page_text_en:
Earth has giant oceans and tiny ponds; towering mountains and rolling hilltops.
Earth has giant oceans and tiny ponds, towering mountains and rolling hilltops.
Earth has four distinct seasons: warm sunshine in spring, stormy showers in summer, falling autumn leaves in autumn, and fluffy snowflakes in winter.
Warm sunshine. Stormy showers. Falling autumn leaves. And fluffy snowflakes.
summary_zh: 本页通过图片和文字展示了地球的多样地貌和四季变化，左侧为冲浪者在巨浪中，右侧配图展示雪中狐狸、雨景和秋树，说明地球有广阔海洋、高山、池塘、小山，并有四季分明的气候特征。

page_text_ocr_zh:
你知道吗？我们的地球只是众多行星中的一颗。
But our planet, Earth, is just one of many planets.
地球上生活着各种各样的动物，有体形庞大的棕熊、柔软可爱的兔子、威武强壮的狮子和蹦蹦跳跳的袋鼠……当然啦，还有我们人类！
Earth has big brown bears and soft cuddly bunnies, mighty lions and bouncy kangaroos. And people, too.
page_text_en:
Did you know? Our Earth is just one of many planets.
But our planet, Earth, is just one of many planets.
Earth is home to all kinds of animals, from huge brown bears and soft, cuddly bunnies to mighty lions and bouncy kangaroos... and, of course, humans!
Earth has big brown bears and soft cuddly bunnies, mighty lions and bouncy kangaroos. And people, too.
summary_zh: 本页通过图片和文字介绍了地球上的动物多样性，展示了棕熊、兔子、狮子和袋鼠等，并指出地球只是众多行星中的一颗。

page_text_ocr_zh:
行星围绕恒星旋转。宇宙中，有无数颗恒星，地球的恒星是太阳。有8颗行星在各自的轨道上，绕着太阳不停地转啊转。
A planet travels around a star. There are billions of stars in our universe. Our star is the sun. The sun holds eight large planets in paths that go round and round.
这些行星会待在自己的轨道上不停地转，都是因为一种叫作万有引力的东西。
也是因为有了万有引力，你才不会飘到太空中去。
太阳
太阳系
太阳系
page_text_en:
Planets orbit around stars. In the universe, there are billions of stars, and Earth's star is the Sun. Eight planets travel in their own orbits, constantly circling the Sun.
A planet travels around a star. There are billions of stars in our universe. Our star is the sun. The sun holds eight large planets in paths that go round and round.
These planets stay in their orbits and keep spinning because of something called gravity.
It's also because of gravity that you don't float off into space.
Sun
Solar System
Solar System
summary_zh: 本页通过图文介绍了太阳系的基本结构，说明行星围绕恒星（太阳）运行，并解释了万有引力的作用，使行星保持在轨道上，也使人类不会飘入太空。

summary_zh: 本页展示了太阳系的行星地图，标注了太阳及八大行星的位置和名称，并通过中英文文字说明地球是距离太阳第三颗行星，同时设有互动问题引导读者思考。

page_text_ocr_zh:
水星
火星的表面有许多红色的铁矿石，所以它看起来红红的。
4颗离太阳比较近的行星都是由岩石和金属组成的。在8颗行星中，这4颗比较温暖。不过，对人类来说，最靠近太阳的那两颗行星实在是太热了！
The four planets closest to the sun are made of rock and metal. They are the warmest of all the planets. But the two closest are a little too warm for us!
火星表面
火星探测器
我们的地球刚好处在一个合适的位置，这个地方不冷也不热，科学家们把它叫作“宜居带”。
Earth is in just the right spot, called the Goldilocks zone. People live where it's not too cold or too hot!
地球
page_text_en:
Mercury
The surface of Mars has many red iron ores, so it looks red.
The four planets closest to the sun are made of rock and metal. They are the warmest of all the planets. But the two closest are a little too warm for us!
Mars surface
Mars rover
Our Earth is in just the right spot, called the Goldilocks zone. This place is neither too cold nor too hot, and scientists call it the "habitable zone".
Earth is in just the right spot, called the Goldilocks zone. People live where it's not too cold or too hot!
Earth
summary_zh: 本页介绍了太阳系内靠近太阳的四颗岩石行星，特别是火星的表面特征，并解释了地球位于‘宜居带’，温度适宜，适合人类生存。

page_text_ocr_zh:
天王星
4颗离太阳比较远的行星是气态巨星，它们在太空中嗖嗖地旋转。与岩质行星不同，它们没有坚硬的地面。
There are four gas giants that whoosh and swirl way out in space. They don't have a hard ground like the rocky planets.
行星的光环
Ring Around the Planet
一些行星外面环绕着光环。土星的光环由尘土和冰粒组成。在阳光的照射下，冰粒闪闪发光，形成了漂亮的土星环。
Some planets have rings around them. Saturn's rings are made of dust and ice. Sunlight reflects off the ice and makes the rings sparkle.
土星环的特写照片。
page_text_en:
Uranus
4 planets that are farther from the Sun are gas giants. They whoosh and swirl in space. Unlike rocky planets, they don't have a hard ground.
There are four gas giants that whoosh and swirl way out in space. They don't have a hard ground like the rocky planets.
Ring Around the Planet
Some planets have rings around them. Saturn's rings are made of dust and ice. Sunlight reflects off the ice and makes the rings sparkle.
Some planets have rings around them. Saturn's rings are made of dust and ice. Sunlight reflects off the ice and makes the rings sparkle.
Close-up photo of Saturn's rings.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了太阳系中距离太阳较远的四颗气态巨行星，以天王星为例说明其没有坚硬地面的特征，并通过图文解释了行星光环的形成，重点介绍了土星环由尘土和冰粒组成，在阳光照射下闪闪发光。

page_text_en:
This photo of Pluto was taken by a spacecraft from 450,000 kilometers away.

In addition to these 8 planets, our solar system also has 5 dwarf planets. They are much bigger than rocks, but much smaller than planets, so they are called dwarf planets.
Five teeny-tiny planets called dwarf planets can be found in our solar system, too. They're too small to be called regular planets, but they're too big to be just rocks.

Rocket launching, heading into space.

Some dwarf planets are very far away. If you could travel to the farthest one in a rocket, it would take up to 30 years to get there!
summary_zh: 本页介绍了太阳系中的5颗矮行星，解释了它们的定义，并通过图文说明了矮行星距离地球非常遥远，乘坐火箭前往最远的矮行星需要30年时间。

page_text_ocr_zh:
疯狂的天气
Wild Weather!
其他行星上的天气可不像地球上这么舒服。
The weather on other planets is not like here on Earth.
金星平时的温度比地球上夏天最炎热的时候还要热上400倍。
金星表面
木星和金星上的大风有时候一刮就是好几年！
巨大的沙尘暴在火星上刮了好几个月。
冥王星和它的卫星卡戎。
当冥王星转到距离太阳较远的地方时，环绕着它的气体会结冰，然后像雪花一样飘落下来。
page_text_en:
Wild Weather!

The weather on other planets is not like here on Earth.

Venus's usual temperature is 400 times hotter than the hottest summer day on Earth.

Venus surface

Jupiter and Venus have strong winds that can blow for years!

Huge dust storms on Mars can last for months.

Pluto and its moon Charon.

When Pluto moves to a place farther from the Sun, the gases around it freeze and fall like snow.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了太阳系中不同行星的极端天气现象，包括金星的高温、木星和金星的持久风暴、火星的沙尘暴，以及冥王星上气体结冰如雪花飘落的奇特天气。

page_text_ocr_zh:
木星和它的卫星。

Some planets have moons. Moons are rocks or ice that circle a planet.
地球只有一颗卫星，而木星却有60多颗卫星！

宇航员乘坐宇宙飞船到达月球需要3天时间。要是从地球去木星的卫星，得花一年多的时间。
It took astronauts in a spaceship three days to reach our moon. It would take more than a year to fly from Earth to Jupiter's moons.
page_text_en:
Jupiter and its moons.
Some planets have moons. Moons are rocks or ice that circle a planet.
Earth has only one moon, while Jupiter has more than 60 moons!
Earth and its moon.
It took astronauts in a spaceship three days to reach our moon. It would take more than a year to fly from Earth to Jupiter's moons.
summary_zh: 本页通过图文对比介绍了木星及其众多卫星，以及地球和月球的关系，并说明了卫星的定义，同时用宇航员前往月球和木星卫星所需时间的对比，展示了太阳系内不同天体间的距离差异。

page_text_en:
Our solar system might seem like a very big place, but it's just one solar system in a galaxy called the Milky Way. So far, scientists have counted 500 other solar systems in our galaxy.

The Milky Way is just one of hundreds of billions of galaxies in the universe! If you started counting now, it would take you 30 years to count to just one billion.
summary_zh: 本页通过图文对比，介绍了太阳系在银河系中的渺小地位，并进一步说明银河系只是宇宙中无数星系之一，强调了宇宙的浩瀚无垠。

page_text_ocr_zh:
你好,邻居!
Howdy, neighbor!
宇宙中有那么多行星,那么,外太空是不是也有其他的人类或动物呢?专门研究太空的天文学家也很想知道这个问题的答案。
With so many planets, you might wonder if there are other people or animals out in space. Astronomers are space scientists who wonder the same thing.
有了开普勒太空望远镜,科学家们就能在地球上探索太空了。
天文学家利用望远镜观察夜空,利用电脑寻找和地球差不多的行星。现在,他们已经找到一些这样的行星了!
Astronomers use telescopes to explore the night sky. They use computers to help them search for planets that are the most like Earth. They have already found a few!
位于智利拉塞雷纳的天文台。
page_text_en:
Hello, neighbor!
Howdy, neighbor!
With so many planets in the universe, you might wonder if there are other people or animals out in space. Astronomers, who are space scientists, also wonder the same thing.
With the Kepler Space Telescope, scientists can explore space from Earth.
Astronomers use telescopes to observe the night sky and use computers to search for planets similar to Earth. Now, they have already found a few!
Astronomers use telescopes to explore the night sky. They use computers to help them search for planets that are the most like Earth. They have already found a few!
Located at the La Serena Observatory in Chile.
summary_zh: 本页探讨了外太空是否存在其他生命的问题，并介绍了天文学家如何利用望远镜和电脑在地球上寻找与地球相似的行星，同时展示了开普勒太空望远镜和智利拉塞雷纳天文台的图片。

page_text_ocr_zh:
抬头看看星空吧!
Look up!
说不定等你长大以后，就有机会搭乘火箭去火星玩了！在那之前，多抬头看看星空，仔细观察那些一闪一闪的星星——那里会有什么呢？大胆地去想象吧！
Maybe one day when you're all grown up, you will be able to board a rocket to Mars! Until then, look up at the night sky, watch, wonder, and imagine what else is out there.
page_text_en:
Look up at the sky!
Look up!
Maybe one day when you're all grown up, you will be able to board a rocket to Mars! Until then, look up at the night sky, watch, wonder, and imagine what else is out there.
summary_zh: 本页以一幅大人和孩子在星空下仰望的剪影图，配以鼓励性文字，呼吁读者抬头观察星空，激发对宇宙的好奇心和想象力，展望未来探索火星的可能性。

page_text_en:
Build an Alien
If astronomers did find life on other planets, what do you think those aliens would look like? Would they have ...
Round eyes like a spider?
Flat feet like a duck?
A long nose like an elephant?
Big antlers like a moose?
A huge tail like a dolphin?
Take out a piece of paper and draw the alien you imagine!
Hello
summary_zh: 本页通过图文互动引导孩子想象外星生命形态，提供蜘蛛眼睛、鸭子脚掌、大象鼻子、驼鹿鹿角、海豚尾巴等动物特征作为创意元素，并鼓励孩子动手画出自己想象中的外星人。
